rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance relocation payments for no-fault evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation. For notices served 3/1/2026–2/28/2027: $8,245 per tenant, max $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly (60+), disabled tenant or household with a minor child.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.effective_date_note: Document gives only annually adjusted rate periods (current period begins 2026-03-01); original enactment date not stated.
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant; max $24,733 per unit; +$5,497 per elderly/disabled/minor-child household (notices 3/1/26–2/28/27)
rules.coverage_conditions: Evictions in SF covered by the Rent Ordinance; temporary capital improvement evictions under 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9 instead.
rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9.

unverifiable_exemptions: Rent Ordinance exemptions (e.g., owner type, subsidized housing)

rules.title: SF relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act are owed relocation payments. For notices served 3/1/2026–2/28/2027: $11,110.05 per tenant, max $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.
citation_aliases: SF Rent Ordinance Ellis Act relocation
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.effective_date_note: Document gives only annually adjusted rate periods (current period begins 2026-03-01).
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; max $33,330.13 per unit; +$7,443.90 per elderly/disabled tenant (notices 3/1/26–2/28/27)

parsed.doc_summary: SF Rent Board archive of relocation payment rates, including the current 3/1/2026–2/28/2027 amounts, for no-fault evictions under Rent Ordinance § 37.9C and for Ellis Act evictions.
